run_ABX_evaluation: run the ABX evaluation script to compute within and across speaker scores on audio features
run_ABX_within_mode: run the ABX evaluation in within speaker mode using cosine distance on precomputed features
run_ABX_across_mode: run the ABX evaluation in across speaker mode sampling multiple speakers per AB pair
run_ABX_with_checkpoint: run the ABX evaluation using a CPC checkpoint to extract features from raw audio files
run_ABX_gpu: run the ABX evaluation with CUDA enabled for faster distance computation on the GPU
